name: RoRED
description: Relation extraction is an important task for structuring information from unstructured text. However, the Romanian language still lacks dedicated datasets and benchmarks for this task. To address this gap, we introduce RoRED, a Romanian relation extraction dataset built by combining two complementary data construction strategies: translating existing high-quality English resources and applying distant supervision to native Romanian Wikipedia data. We leverage a powerful open-source large language model to automatically translate English examples into Romanian.
